vessels.name: Borrowed Skiff
vessels.description: Odessa's loaner. Smells of bait and old rope, but it floats and it forgives.

vessels.name: Wavecutter Jet Ski
vessels.description: Brick's old competition ski, lightning off the line and thin as an eggshell.
vessels.unlock_hint: Reach renown level 1, then buy it at the shipyard.

vessels.name: Pelican Catamaran
vessels.description: Twin hulls and a stubborn temperament. It shrugs off weather that would crack lesser boats.
vessels.unlock_hint: Reach renown level 2, then buy it at the shipyard.

vessels.name: Mudlark Dredger
vessels.description: A salvage trawler with a winch arm and deep lockers. Slow, greedy, dependable.
vessels.unlock_hint: Reach renown level 3, then buy it at the shipyard.

vessels.name: Cobalt Swift
vessels.description: A regatta hull built for one thing. The water barely notices it passing.
vessels.unlock_hint: Win the Shallows regatta, then buy it at the shipyard.

vessels.name: Lantern Jane
vessels.description: Raised from Wreckwater plank by plank. She remembers you, and the sea remembers her.
vessels.unlock_hint: Follow the Almanac's story to its end.
